## Migrations

- [ ] No migrations

## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] Every new route/action is authorised by a Policy, and has a "different family → 404" test
- [ ] New data leaving the server goes through a Resource that applies privacy rules
- [ ] User input is validated in a Form Request
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real family data in the diff
- [ ] Audit log entries written for new create/update/delete actions
